Claude iPhone reminders: 3 steps from chat to to-do list. Reminders work on iPhone only.

1. Plan - Make a plan with Claude in the iPhone app.
2. Ask - Say: add these to my reminders.
3. Allow - Choose Allow once or Always allow. Android uses calendar instead.
